$about: Procedural glowing cracks. Every key here is a shader uniform (surfaceSize is also the mesh scale), so edits land on the next frame and nothing is rebuilt or recompiled. The three layers — base surface, crack core, outer glow — are independent on purpose: re-colour them and the same shader is lava, an arcane fracture or a cracked energy shield. Defaults are a dark volcanic surface; the lab's preset buttons show the other palettes. Tune in the lab, then paste the exported JSON back over this file.
